name: Function_Composition_Isomorphism
description: Map the discrete states {1, 2, 3} to three specific linear modular functions. The inequality constraint between two nodes is exactly mapped to the condition that the composition of their assigned functions does not yield the identity function. This obscures the simple graph-coloring nature of the problem, baiting models into writing complex composition evaluators or failing to recognize the early-pruning opportunities of a simple CSP.
